newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Minsa says $25 mln for new maize plant.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Minsa says $25 mln for new maize plant.

text.p: Grupo Minsa, Mexico's second-largest maker of corn flour, has set aside $25 million for building a new plant in central Mexico, the company CEO told reporters on Tuesday.
"The initial investment will be $25 million, and we are thinking of building a new plant to produce 180,000 tonnes per year," Minsa CEO Juan Gargallo said.
Corn flour is used to produce tortillas, a staple of the Mexican diet for centuries.
Minsa is a former state-owned company that has about 30 percent of the Mexican market.
